outcome: A discount code takes its percentage off a cart, behind the flag the rollout plan names.

acceptance_criteria.text: A discount takes its percentage off the subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent.

expected_verification.assertion: a 10% discount on a subtotal of 1333 charges 1200

acceptance_criteria.text: A cart with no discount charges exactly what it charged before.

expected_verification.assertion: the same cart with no discount charges 1333

data_impact: None. No stored order is rewritten.
security_impact: None. A discount percentage is supplied by the pricing service, not by the shopper.
rollout: Behind `checkout_discount_codes`, which stays off in every environment until the pricing team has signed the codes off. Turning it on is a separate change.
